reason: The README describes a chat-integrated canvas for rendering AI-generated HTML and interactively editing its visible text, making visualization the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 在聊天旁的可调整大小画布中渲染 AI 生成的 HTML，并支持点击页面文字进行编辑。
summaries.en: Renders AI-generated HTML in a resizable canvas beside the chat and lets users edit visible page text by clicking it.
